citations.narrative:
- During the review of records, the licensee was unable to provide complete disposition records for birds. Cage cards are
used to document births; however, these records are discarded after rearing and are not maintained. The facility tracks
the number of birds sold but does not maintain records of birds that died or were euthanized.
Failure to maintain complete acquisition and disposition records interferes with the ability to accurately identify animals
and trace their movement. The licensee shall make, keep, and maintain records that fully and correctly disclose
information concerning regulated
animals purchased, born, hatched or otherwise acquired, as well as animals transported, sold, euthanized, or otherwise
disposed.
Correct from 25 September 2026 onward

- Multiple juvenile enclosures had an insufficient number of perches available for the number of birds housed in the
enclosure. One juvenile cage had no perches at all. Enclosures housing perching birds must have a sufficient number of
appropriate
perches to comfortably hold all birds at the same time. Lack of perching space can be a potential source of stress to the
enclosed animals. Licensee must ensure that each cage has an appropriate number of birds for that space.
Correct by: 30 September 2026

citations.desc: Cleaning, sanitization, housekeeping, and pest control.
citations.narrative:
- Many enclosures throughout the facility had an excessive accumulation of debris, dust, feathers, and cobwebs on the
outside of the cages. At least two cages housing juvenile birds had perches that were heavily soiled and crusted with
waste and debris. Excreta and waste must be removed from under and around primary enclosures as often as necessary
to prevent excessive accumulation of waste, to prevent soiling of the birds contained in the primary enclosures, and to
reduce disease hazards, insects, pests, and odors. The facility must clean around the cages and must ensure that all
cages are regularly and adequately cleaned on an ongoing basis.
Correct by 30 September 2026
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with licensee.
